description: This script implements self-healing mechanisms for Wi-Fi interfaces and related components. It monitors Wi-Fi radio status, manages restarts of Wi-Fi services, checks for stuck Wi-Fi states, handles device memory thresholds, and performs hardware/component resets under certain conditions to ensure Wi-Fi stability.

methods.name: onewifi_restart_wifi
methods.description: Restarts the onewifi service and logs the action.

methods.name: vap_restart
methods.description: Triggers a self-heal action for specified Wi-Fi access points.

methods.name: print_wifi_2g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Logs the current counts of Wi-Fi 2G probe requests and responses.

methods.name: sync_all_wifi_2g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Synchronizes and updates the counters for Wi-Fi 2G probe requests and responses.

methods.name: check_wifi_2g_stuck_status
methods.description: Checks if the Wi-Fi 2G radio is stuck and initiates reinitialization if needed.

methods.name: print_wifi_5g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Logs the current counts of Wi-Fi 5G probe requests and responses.

methods.name: sync_all_wifi_5g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Synchronizes and updates the counters for Wi-Fi 5G probe requests and responses.

methods.name: check_wifi_5g_stuck_status
methods.description: Checks if the Wi-Fi 5G radio is stuck and initiates reinitialization if needed.

methods.name: check_bss_queue_full
methods.description: Checks whether the basic service set (BSS) queues are full.

methods.name: wave_driver_restart
methods.description: Restarts the wave driver components for specific device models.

methods.name: check_bss_queue_one_min
methods.description: Checks the BSS queue status repeatedly over one minute.

methods.name: onewifi_conn_clients_count
methods.description: Counts total connected Wi-Fi clients across all radios.

methods.name: check_lnf_status
methods.description: Checks and manages LightNFind (LNFs) for 2G, 5G, and 6G radios, enabling them if disabled.

methods.name: onewifi_mem_restart
methods.description: Monitors RAM usage of the OneWifi process and restarts it if thresholds are exceeded, considering maintenance windows and connected clients for decision-making.
